== Notes ==
* This skill will affect both targeted enchantments targeted at the caster as well as all [[Target#Untargeted skills|untargeted]] enchantment spells (which include party-wide enchantments such as [[Aegis]]).
** Combines well with [[Mystic Healing]] and [[Orders build]] skills.
** Consider using this signet to cast [[Eternal Aura]] instantly to [[resurrect]] allies in mid-battle.
* Even though enchantments are made to cast instantly, they are still [[Skill queue|queued]] and cannot be cast while [[Movement|moving]], [[knock down|knocked down]] etc.
* Unlike Flash enchantments, this skill does not cause enchantments to bypass aftercast delay.

{{bug|The counter does not reset if the signet is recast before the original [[duration]] ends.}}
